name: knoxx-colab
description: Work in browser Colab notebooks and run bounded remote compute jobs through the authenticated Knoxx gateway.

interface.longDescription: Inspect, edit and execute your browser-connected Colab notebook, or run bounded CPU/GPU/TPU jobs with the official Colab CLI without keeping a tab open. Includes account compute-unit usage, job output and verified runtime cleanup. Google credentials stay in isolated services on Stealth.
interface.defaultPrompt: Check my Colab connection and help me work in the connected notebook.
